question: After the pacing defect is fixed, should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove either implementation, but the choice changes operator visibility and upgrade behavior for existing ambiguous rows, so it needs maintainer product/operations intent.

options.title: Accept recoverable pending after repair
options.body: Merge after the no-op pacing fix if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter entries to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or operator surfacing ships.

options.title: Keep fail-closed state
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery ledger is designed.

options.title: Require operator surface first
options.body: Ask for a doctor, UI, or API surface before changing ambiguous entries to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept recoverable pending after repair
recommendation.body: Merge after the no-op pacing fix if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter entries to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or operator surfacing ships.
